## HEADNOTE
Sample Tenancy Act, 2001, Section 7 - security deposit - deposit exceeding two months' rent is recoverable in excess; refund due within thirty days of vacating.
## FACTS
The society took a deposit equal to five months' rent from the tenant and did not refund it after she vacated the flat in 2010.
## ARGUMENTS
The society argued that the deposit was agreed freely and the tenant was bound by the lease. The tenant relied on the cap in Section 7.
## REASONING
Section 7, as it stood in 2011, limited a security deposit to two months' rent. A contract term exceeding the cap is void to the extent of the excess. The tenant is entitled to the excess immediately and to the balance within thirty days of vacating.
## HOLDING
The excess over two months' rent must be refunded with interest, and the balance refunded within thirty days of vacating.
